compiled_state.title: GREEN: Update review-stop-check.sh and session-misc-functions.sh to severity-based message
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
Supporting user-visible messaging consistency with DD2 (severity-based pass/fail).

## Files to modify
1. plugins/dso/hooks/review-stop-check.sh (line 77)
2. plugins/dso/hooks/lib/session-misc-functions.sh (line 275)

## Implementation

### review-stop-check.sh (line 77)
Change:
  echo "  2. Fix any issues (scores must be >= 4)"
To:
  echo "  2. Fix any issues (findings must have no critical, important, or fragile severity)"

### session-misc-functions.sh (line 275)
Change:
  echo "  2. Fix any issues (scores must be >= 4)"
To:
  echo "  2. Fix any issues (findings must have no critical, important, or fragile severity)"

These are the two places where the old score-threshold message was displayed to users. The new message correctly describes the severity-based gate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] review-stop-check.sh does not contain 'scores must be >= 4'
  Verify: ! grep -q 'scores must be >= 4' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/review-stop-check.sh
- [ ] session-misc-functions.sh does not contain 'scores must be >= 4'
  Verify: ! grep -q 'scores must be >= 4' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/lib/session-misc-functions.sh
- [ ] review-stop-check.sh contains new severity-based message
  Verify: grep -q 'findings must have no critical' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/review-stop-check.sh
- [ ] session-misc-functions.sh contains new severity-based message
  Verify: grep -q 'findings must have no critical' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/lib/session-misc-functions.sh
- [ ] test-review-stop-check.sh still passes
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-review-stop-check.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

If any code reads score= for logic (not just display), update it to use severity-based logic instead.
